name: Doña Ana County, NM
findings: Doña Ana County has 497 nonprofit organizations. 207 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 162 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Doña Ana County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Doña Ana County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 25 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few union organizations list membership
observations.text: No union organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through union groups? Where else does that happen?
